text:
Devon: Quick heads-up — I pushed OKR draft v2 to the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/okr-q3-v2. Need alignment + sign-off by EOD Thursday. Biggest change is we tightened scope on ‘interactive embeddings’ and deferred multi-tenant billing. Please read the callouts under 'launch gates'.
Maria: Thanks — reading now. Can you call out the Dedicated SLA ask? customers keep pinging for 99.9.
Devon: Yep — new line item under Reliability: target 99.9 for Dedicated customers, but we mark it as 'depends on infra hiring' (see risk row).
Alex: Heads up from eng — we only have 60% capacity for new infra work this quarter because of two large migration projects. 99.9 SLA rollout for Dedicated likely Q4 unless we reprioritize.
Priya: We have a named customer (AcmeHealth) pushing private deployment + audit logs by launch. If we de-prioritize multi-tenant billing, they ask for a paid Dedicated slot instead.
Omar: If AcmeHealth converts, that's material revenue. Can we do a narrow compliance-only private package to unblock them without full multi-tenant billing?
Alex: Technically feasible to offer a one-off private image + audit hooks as a stopgap. Still needs 2 weeks infra effort + 1 week product integration. That fits if we move the experimental 'dev tooling' epic to stretch.
Tia: On success metrics: recommend adding a quality guard for embeddings — avg normalized recall >= 0.72 on our eval set. If we loosen the feature scope, we should keep that as a non-negotiable gate.
Maria: Agreed on the metric. Also propose a soft-launch path: 1 customer pilot -> staged rollout -> GA. Lowers blast radius.
Devon: Updated doc with the soft-launch plan and the recall gate. Also added a fallback policy: if infra can't meet 99.9 we default Dedicated traffic to supported model variants and flag customers.
pm-bot: Document updated by Devon (devon@redwood) — version 2.1 — comment: "added launch gate language and pilot plan"
Alex: Quick ask from eng leads — if we push Acme pilot into Q3 we need decision by Mon so hiring and capacity can be reshuffled.
Priya: I'll confirm Acme's timeline today and get them to commit to a pilot start date.
Omar: Let's align: Devon — update OKR to mark Acme pilot as conditional milestone, Alex — work with your leads on the 'two-week private image' plan and resourcing. We'll do final sign-off Thurs EOD. :thumbsup:
Maria: :eyes: will review the updated doc and reply with any micro-edits before Thurs.
Devon: Thanks all — will make the doc edits now and ping when done.
